target_customer: Parents of children aged 8 to 16, mainly in Singapore and Asia, paying for live 1 on 1 online coding and math classes
problem: Kids find school math and coding dull and parents want engaging tutoring. Strive teaches math and coding through live one to one classes with vetted tutors.
business_model: Per class tuition ($65 per one hour class on the current site) with trial class refund
product_category: Online coding and math tutoring for kids

founders.name: Pulkit Agarwal
founders.background_notes: YC page profile; teaching assistant roles at Georgia Tech and Stanford. Met co-founder through Entrepreneur First per a Going Southeast interview (summary).

founders.name: Tamir Shklaz
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in TechCrunch (2023-02-20); not listed on the YC page. Moved to Singapore from South Africa per interview summary.

competitors.name: Codingal
competitors.what: Online live coding classes for K12 kids, also YC Winter 2021
competitors.funding_then: YC investment reported 2021-02; 1.2M seed reported 2021-09 (after batch)

competitors.name: Tynker
competitors.traction_then: Established platform; reported sale to Byju's in 2021-09

competitors.name: WhiteHat Jr
competitors.what: Live online coding classes for kids, India

technical_complexity.rationale: A tutor marketplace with scheduling, video classes and curriculum; operations and teacher quality matter more than engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Tutoring is easy to replicate; curriculum and tutor certification (fewer than 1 percent of applicants per the site) offer limited differentiation.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large edtech players already ran live coding classes for kids; no source shows any copying or acquiring Strive.

market_need_then: Pandemic era demand for online kids enrichment was high, and Byju's paid reported 300M for WhiteHat Jr in 2020 and 200M for Tynker in 2021, which signals demand.

branding.domain_note: Uses strivemath.com; the company also appears as Strive Education Pte on aggregators.

identity.voice_and_tone: Joyful and encouraging; tagline 'Your kid's coding journey starts here'

branding.community_and_virality: Partnership with KrisFlyer, Singapore Airlines' loyalty program, per the company site; no evidence of fan community.

brand_strength.rationale: Aspirational generic name and a loyalty partnership, but little brand press beyond funding coverage.

outcome_analysis: Strive Math is active with about 13 people and one disclosed round, a 1.3M seed in February 2023 led by YC. It sells a service that larger rivals in live coding classes also offered and shows no clear breakout, so it remains a small, capital light stage company rather than a clear success or failure.
notes: Seed confirmed by TechCrunch (2023-02-20) and the company blog (2023-02-21). Aggregators list total 1.3M to 1.53M, unverified differences. Agarwal education comes from the YC page profile. Tamir Shklaz education unknown. No layoffs, shutdown or acquisition found. Name origin not found. WhiteHat Jr source is an EdWeek item summarized by search, not opened.
